# Implementation Plan: Calculator View Modes

**Branch**: `001-calc-view-modes` | **Date**: 2026-05-15 | **Spec**: [spec.md](spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/001-calc-view-modes/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan was generated by the `/speckit-plan` command.

## Summary

Build a static, client-side calculator (vanilla HTML/CSS/ES2020 JS) with two view modes — simple (basic arithmetic) and scientific (extended functions) — that is always viewport-centered and meets WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility requirements. The implementation uses a pure-function state machine, a custom in-repo test harness, and a GitHub Actions CI workflow.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: HTML5, CSS3, ES2020+ (vanilla JS — no transpilation, no bundler)

**Primary Dependencies**: None (Zero-dependency per Constitution Principle I)

**Storage**: N/A (client-side only, no persistence between sessions)

**Testing**: Custom in-repo test harness (`tests/harness.js`, plain JS assertions, Node 22-compatible via `"type": "module"`)

**Target Platform**: Modern browsers — Chrome, Firefox, Safari (latest stable); Node.js 22 LTS for CI test execution

**Project Type**: Static web application (single HTML entry point + CSS + ES2020 JS modules)

**Performance Goals**: Mode switch ≤ 1 second response time (SC-001)

**Constraints**: WCAG 2.1 AA, no build step, no external services, CI must run without secrets

**Scale/Scope**: ~6 source files (index.html, style.css, calc.js, ui.js, tests/harness.js, tests/test-calc.js)

### Source Code (repository root)

```text
index.html              # Entry point — markup, ARIA attributes, mode toggle
style.css               # All styles — viewport centering, button layout, responsive
src/
├── calc.js             # Pure calculator state machine (no DOM dependencies)
└── ui.js               # DOM wiring: event listeners + render to DOM

tests/
├── harness.js          # Custom TestRunner + assert utilities
├── run.js              # Test entry point (imports all test suites)
└── test-calc.js        # Unit tests for calc.js state machine

.github/
└── workflows/
    └── ci.yml          # GitHub Actions: syntax check + test run

package.json            # { "type": "module", "scripts": { "test": "node tests/run.js" } }
```

**Structure Decision**: Single-project static web app. No backend/frontend split — all code runs in the browser, tests run in Node via ES2020 modules. The `src/` split between `calc.js` (pure logic, fully testable in Node) and `ui.js` (DOM layer, tested via acceptance tests) is the only structural separation needed.
